messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: API gateway spike — 5xx rate increased from 0.7% to 12% in last 5m. Primary error: TLS handshake failures / 'tls: handshake failure' (region: eu-west-1). Paging oncall.
alice (oncall): acked. I’m looking now. PID and logs coming up.
alice (oncall): carla, bob — you around? I might need infra help for cert/rotation.
carla (sre): here, joining. seeing similar spikes in envoy logs: lots of 'remote error: tls: unknown_ca' and 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority'.
bob (infra): oncall birthing? I’m available. Any recent cert rotations on the edge?
ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: cert-rotator job completed 2026-03-14T10:12:03Z for domain api.redwood.example — new cert pushed to edge-proxy pool (rotation-id: r-20260314-1012).
alice (oncall): that matches the timeline. hypothesis: rotation pushed an incomplete chain (missing intermediate). Quick smoke: openssl to one failing endpoint.
alice (oncall): ```
openssl s_client -connect api-eu1.edge.redwood.example:443 -servername api.redwood.example -showcerts
# ...
CONNECTED(00000003)
1400... error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert unknown ca
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=api.redwood.example
   i:/CN=ACME Intermediate CA
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
(MISSING INTERMEDIATE)
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```
alice (oncall): server only served leaf cert; intermediate not present. older clients/clients that don't have intermediate cached will fail.
kevin (prod-support): we've started getting customer tickets from EU partners: connections failing, 502 responses. CS is triaging — marking P1 impact if it persists.
carla (sre): checking edge-proxy config (envoy). current cert bundle on disk under /etc/edge/certs/api.redwood.example.crt shows only leaf.
bob (infra): certs are pulled from vault at /secrets/cert-uploads; cert-rotator expected to concatenate fullchain.pem + privkey. Looks like post-rotation step that concatenates intermediate failed due to a nil file at rotation time.
alice (oncall): immediate mitigation: can we manually upload full chain (from backup) and trigger envoy hot-reload? If yes, do it; otherwise fallback routing to other region for EU.
bob (infra): I have previous fullchain in s3: s3://redwood-cert-backups/api.redwood.example/fullchain-20260314-0910.pem. I'll pull and push to edge nodes.
bob (infra): running remote copy to edge nodes (parallel):
```
for NODE in eu1-edge{1..4}; do scp fullchain-20260314-0910.pem $NODE:/etc/edge/certs/api.redwood.example.crt; ssh $NODE 'systemctl reload envoy'; done
```
deploy-bot: rolling config reload across 4 nodes initiated by bob (infra).
alice (oncall): watch metrics after reload. I’ll keep pager open.
carla (sre): metrics: 5xx rate dropping on node eu1-edge1 within 30s. overall 5xx from 12% -> 3.2% in next 2m.
kevin (prod-support): CS: telling customers we are investigating and expect mitigation within 15-30m. Affected customers mostly EU region. No data loss.
ops-bot: cert-rotator job status: last run succeeded but post-hook returned exit code 0 with no error logs; investigating why intermediate vanished.
alice (oncall): good mitigation. next: root cause for rotation failure — cert-rotator didn't include intermediate. Who owns the rotator job?
bob (infra): I own it. Reproducing locally now. Looks like when ACME responded, intermediate file was written to tmp and then a cleanup script removed it prematurely during bundling race. We had an edge-case when ACME server returned chain in a different order.
carla (sre): action items: 1) patch cert-rotator to validate fullchain assembled and fail rotation if chain incomplete. 2) add a canary check: post-rotation run openssl s_client from multiple client stacks to validate chain. 3) add alert for tls: unknown_ca spikes.
alice (oncall): agree. For now, postmortem and customer comms: mitigation time 2026-03-14T10:15Z — manual restore of fullchain completed by bob. Total impact window ~ 3m initial spike, but some residual errors for 27m as caches propagated.
kevin (prod-support): marking incident P1 for CS tracking due to widespread customer errors and active tickets. Drafting customer follow-up email: "We experienced TLS handshake failures due to incomplete certificate chain after automated rotation. Services restored after manual redeployment of full chain. We are implementing safeguards to prevent recurrence."
alice (oncall): logging notes: capture the rotation logs, rotator job logs, envoy logs around 10:12-10:20. I'll stash into incident channel and attach to postmortem.
bob (infra): pushing hotfix for rotator now: add validation and atomic write. Will open PR, link in thread.
bob (infra): ```
# quick verification script
cat /etc/edge/certs/api.redwood.example.crt | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer
# should show leaf then intermediate entries
```
carla (sre): add synthetic canary in eu-west-1 that runs every 1m: openssl s_client -> verify chain + curl health endpoint with TLS handshake check.
alice (oncall): handoff note for next oncall: incident mitigated, manual replace done, root cause: race/bug in cert-rotator that produced incomplete chain. Follow-ups: fix rotator, add canary + alerting, run a replay of rotation in staging, customer follow-up drafted by kevin. If anything reoccurs page SRE senior.
carla (sre): creating incident ticket and assigning follow-ups. ETA for rotator fix PR review by EOD today.
kevin (prod-support): will send initial customer update within 45m and a follow-up with RCA after postmortem.
alice (oncall): closing active pager; marking incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. leaving channel open for handoff.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated by alice (oncall) at 2026-03-14T10:17:12Z. Please file postmortem with timeline and action items.
alice (oncall): handing off to night oncall. leaving notes in incident board. good job team :thumbsup:
